hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\") or \"\")" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$FILE" == *"/src/routes/"* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *"route-tree.gen"* ]]; then echo "[hook] Route file edited → run: pnpm router:generate"; fi; if [[ "$FILE" == *"/locales/"* ]] && [[ "$FILE" == *".json" ]]; then echo "[hook] Locale file edited → run: pnpm i18n:resources"; fi'
